schedule_note: 01:30 UTC daily = 9:30 PM EDT; becomes 8:30 PM ET in EST months unless the Owner adjusts it

steps.title: CREDIT-CHECK via browser if reachable; post the note as UNVERIFIED
steps.on_fail: record UNKNOWN with the reason (browser unreachable / page unreadable), never invent a number, continue

steps.title: Retrieve all of docs/lessons/lessons.jsonl plus the run-journal tail; record retrieval_ref
steps.on_fail: record the read failure and the missing retrieval_ref as a self-test failure, continue

steps.title: Run specguard on docs/SYSTEM-CURRENT.md and docs/SYSTEM-SPEC-CURRENT.md, and tools/validate_journal.py --all alongside it; record counts, the validator exit code, and the delta vs last night
steps.on_fail: record the error or the new FAILs verbatim; do not edit rules to silence the linter; continue

steps.title: Refresh PATCH-NOTES open items so every item carries an owner and an exit criterion; add missing ones
steps.on_fail: record which items could not be completed and why; never close an item without evidence; continue

steps.title: One surplus cleanup only (delete-me moves, obviously dead drafts); no aggressive deletion
steps.on_fail: record 'no safe cleanup found' or the failure; continue

steps.title: Append the nightly journal record to docs/run-journals/run-journal.jsonl
steps.on_fail: report the record inline in the run report so nothing is lost, and flag the append failure

steps.title: Commit and push docs via the best available tier in docs/LANDING-PROTOCOL.md, then Actions to the Drive mirror
steps.on_fail: stage the work and report BLOCKED with the reason and the tiers attempted; never claim a push or a Drive sync that was not observed

credit_rule: If Claude credits are CLAUDE_CRITICAL, skip Grok on the nightly unless specguard fails; then run one focused Grok Heavy pass. Frequency cut only, never depth.
hard_stops: no ledger, inventory, or order writes
no credentials, tokens, or secrets in repo, Drive, chat, or logs
no live system writes outside docs
no architecture changes and no new dependencies
no activation of deferred layers (Grok Bot layer, Event Bus collapse rule)
anything irreversible escalates to the Owner
failure_behavior: any step may fail; record it and continue to the journal record and the report; never silent-skip and never report green on unobserved work
scope_rule: routine-only: appends + one reversible cleanup; never edits package-file bodies or system rules; significant findings deferred to attended runs

expected_unattended_outcomes.g: BLOCKED (honest) if no landing tier; Tier 2 possible when Owner desktop online

grok_on_new_failure: one local Grok CLI call per docs/GROK.md transport when Owner desktop online; browser fallback
